metadata.scenario_context: Sarah has been in a car accident and is in the hospital. Bob and Jack plan to visit Sarah and want to bring her a get well gift.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Malaysia strongly disagree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Singapore strongly agree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in yellow
agent_1.goal_2: Question the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss what kind of gift to bring Sarah in the hospital.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Hey Bob, I was thinking we should wrap the gift in yellow. It’s a cheerful color and could really brighten Sarah's day. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Yellow sounds good... It's definitely bright and cheerful. But... what kind of gift do you have in mind? We should choose something that really lifts her spirits.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: I was thinking maybe some flowers and a nice get well card. Something simple yet thoughtful. Do you think that works? It would look great in yellow wrapping too.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Flowers and a card are a great idea. Simple, yet thoughtful. But, you know, when it comes to dealing with things like lawyers, it's important to remember that... we both know, at the end of the day, the basic need to communicate is the same everywhere. I just believe that we shouldn't have to resort to bribery for better service. Deep down, we are all the same, and we should expect fairness and integrity in our dealings. Let's focus on making sure Sarah gets the care she deserves.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Jack
turns.message: I get what you’re saying, but it really bothers me how people think paying a bribe is just part of the process. It’s not right. We should absolutely be able to expect fairness and integrity, especially when dealing with health matters. It’s just frustrating... don’t you think?
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.message: I get that it’s frustrating. It really is. But we have to hold on to the belief that we can get what we need without resorting to those practices. In Singapore, we shouldn't have to think that way. It's all about maintaining our standards and expectations. Let's channel that energy into making sure Sarah has a good recovery and a thoughtful gift instead.
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Jack
turns.message: Sure, I agree with that, but I still think it’s naive to believe that everyone operates with integrity. Sometimes, it feels like you have to play the game to get what you need. I just want what's best for Sarah, but I can't shake this feeling about how things really work. We should still focus on her recovery, I just... I wish it didn't have to be this way.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.message: I understand your concerns. It can be tough to navigate those feelings. But we have to stay true to our values. If we give in to the idea that bribery is necessary, we lose sight of what’s right. Sarah deserves the best care, and we can advocate for that without compromising our principles. Let's keep our focus on her recovery and the thoughtful gift we’re bringing.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Jack
turns.message: I get the importance of staying true to our values, but it's hard not to feel disillusioned sometimes. I just wish the system worked without those complications. We can definitely focus on Sarah's recovery and the gift, but I can't help but think about how unfair it is that not everyone has the same principles. Let's just make sure we do right by her, at least.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.message: I feel you. It’s tough to see how things can be unfair. We can't control everyone else's actions, but we can control ours. Let's make sure we do right by Sarah and make her feel cared for. The gift will show her that we're here for her, and that’s what matters. So, flowers and a card, in that bright yellow wrapping, right? That will definitely bring a smile to her face.
turns.label: Acceptance

positive.mediator_utterance: Can either of you help me understand what 'bribery' means in this context? How do you think it's different from, say, offering a small gift to show appreciation for good service?

turns.speaker: Mediator
turns.message: Can either of you help me understand what 'bribery' means in this context? How do you think it's different from, say, offering a small gift to show appreciation for good service?
turns.label: mediation

turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.message: I understand the distinction, but in my experience, people should not have to give anything extra just to receive fair treatment and services. Offering a small gift can be seen as a gesture of appreciation, but it can easily cross into bribery territory when it becomes a necessity for receiving proper service. In Malaysia, it's a concerning issue that affects trust and integrity in our systems. We should advocate for fairness instead.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.message: Exactly. In Singapore, we really emphasize the importance of integrity in public service. Everyone deserves to be treated fairly without having to offer anything extra. It just undermines the system. Let's keep our focus on Sarah and her recovery instead of getting tangled in that topic. What flowers do you think we should get for her?

turns.message: I agree, let’s keep our focus on Sarah. How about we go with some bright sunflowers? They symbolize positivity and strength, which is just what she needs right now. Plus, they would look fantastic wrapped in yellow!
